title: 2026 waste voluntary-MRV scope and exclusions QA controls

sources.title: Voluntary monitoring, reporting and verification (MRV) period for waste incineration
Voluntary MRV period for EfW and waste incineration

facts.source_fact: Non-hazardous waste incineration is in scope where capacity is greater than 3 tonnes per hour.
Hazardous waste incineration is in scope where capacity is greater than 10 tonnes per day.
Clinical waste is included in scope.
A high-temperature hazardous-waste exclusion is described for installations capable of operating at 1,100°C for 2 seconds when composition tests are also met.
The exclusion requires at least 80% hazardous waste in annual input.
The exclusion requires no more than 20% healthcare waste.
The exclusion requires no more than 1% hazardous waste wood.
Annual waste input for the exclusion is assessed over the previous calendar year.
Operators contact their regulator for participation guidance.
Scope status is an installation/activity classification and does not itself provide a quantified emissions value.
